description: A charity exclusive pet unlocked by donating $10 or more to the LoveTropics 48-hour Minecraft charity livestream, raising funds for the Pachamama Alliance — an organization dedicated to protecting the world's rainforests and the indigenous cultures within them. Donors received this one-of-a-kind companion to show off their generosity in-game.
notes: Released as part of the LoveTropics charity event on November 21, 2025. Free rewards (Arm Floaties + Creeper Floaty) were also available to all viewers during the stream.
